notes.title: Patch 1.2.1.0: Now Live!
notes.notes:
WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game!

Fixes a bug where in the first Ongess battle if Cosette was in your party and you're on the bad ending route, the story dialogue could get caught in a loop until you manually restart the battle.

Fixes a potential crash in Battle of Far Port upon victory.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.9: Now Live!
notes.notes:
WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game! 

Contains a hot fix for a bad ending requirement. [spoiler]The Bad end previously would not trigger if you decide to go to Ryuvia, sink every ship except for Arcadius, then capture Arcadius' ship last.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.8: Now Live!
notes.notes:
WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game!

Fixed a bug where Qisah would run off screen in RPG battles after using the special Smash.

Fixed a crash that could occur due to a story forced retreat in RPG battles where Icari was in the middle of using Remeiken.

Fixed a theoretical crash that could occur if a unit is killed in a RPG battle at the same time a buff is being applied.

Fixed various typos.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.7: Now Live!
notes.notes:
WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game!

For users with old GPUs struggling with low FPS, try holding down the letters W, A, T, E, R and the CTRL key at the same time in the battles to turn off the water. This is not recommended if you are above the minimum system requirements found on the store page.

The bounty gain of Divine Prayer is now 2.5x rather than 5x.

The self-fleet wide damage of Divine Prayer has been increased.

Fixed a bug where voiced lines play the wrong voices if you save and load on the first line of the scene.

Fixed a bug which would cause the UI from choices to overlay on top of the Party Status Menu.

Fixed a bug that resulted in Kryska's Counter passive not working in RPG battles.

Fixed a bug that resulted in Kryska's Guard special not working in RPG battles.

Fixed a bug that would cause enemies to follow Kryska off screen while she retreats under the effects of Taunt in RPG battles.

Fixed a bug that would result in the Fire Proof Sails effect from your own ships getting applied to the enemy rather than youself.

Fixed a bug that would lead to Lynn's sprite looping the animation for throwing a shuriken in RPG battles.

Fixed a crash that would occur if you try and proceed past the final scene screen without selecting a girl.

Fixed various typos.
